verdict.rationale: Twenty's Workflows feature explicitly supports rule-based automation: triggers on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks, chaining actions like record operations, HTTP requests, code, branches, AI Agent steps, Slack alerts, and enrichment — a clear rules-trigger-actions automation engine documented with concrete examples (deal stage → Slack alert, new contact → enrichment). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of workflow reliability/complexity limits beyond docs and one general community note about alpha-stage issues (not specific to workflows).
